article_context: The body image introduces practical recommendations for preparing a self-leveling floor before tiling, emphasizing controlled adhesive application on a prepared, even base.
image_reading: One worker kneels on an unfinished floor beside a partially tiled area, holding a notched trowel against visible adhesive.
The trowel, the worker’s hand, and the adhesive surface have a visible contact point; parallel combed ridges show the grounded working process.
Installed tiles, grout lines, and projected red alignment lines form a rigid layout that should remain fixed; no other people or loose tools are visible.

models.positive_prompt: The kneeling worker steadily draws the notched trowel across the exposed adhesive, keeping the blade in contact with the floor as a short new band of parallel ridges forms. The installed tiles and red alignment lines stay rigid and unchanged, and the trowel ends at the edge of the freshly combed band.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds in one fixed-camera shot, the worker immediately continues one moderate, controlled trowel stroke across the exposed adhesive. His torso and working arm shift only as required by the stroke; the blade remains visibly against the floor while the combed band extends gradually. The movement eases near the end with the trowel still touching the adhesive at the new edge, while the tiled section and laser layout remain stable.

models.positive_prompt: The worker pulls the notched trowel smoothly over the open adhesive, maintaining continuous floor contact while evenly spaced grooves extend by one narrow strip. Keep the tile grid and projected red guides fixed; by the final frame the tool rests at the far boundary of the newly textured strip.
models.scene_plan: Use a tripod-locked five-second shot. Let the worker perform one even pull that develops through most of the clip, progressively lengthening a narrow area of uniform adhesive grooves; allow only a restrained weight shift and arm motion tied to that pull. Decelerate naturally in the final moments until the blade reaches the far boundary of the new strip without lifting or beginning another pass.

structured_intent.identity_invariant: Exactly one worker, one held notched trowel, the existing installed tiles, adhesive field, and alignment guides remain present and recognizable.
